name: latentSplat
aliases: Autoencoding Variational Gaussians for Fast Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
definition: A method for generalizable 3D reconstruction from two reference views that predicts semantic 3D Gaussians in a latent space. It models uncertainty explicitly by storing distributions (mean and variance) of spherical harmonic coefficients for each Gaussian, allowing sampling of specific instances for rendering.
summary: latentSplat is a fast, generalizable 3D reconstruction method that predicts semantic 3D Gaussians in a latent space, handling ambiguity better than regression-based approaches while remaining orders of magnitude faster than diffusion models.
